title: incident-bot: surface actionable runbook links in oncall diagnostics
author: Maya Thompson
description: Summary: Surface prioritized, actionable runbook links and short actionable summaries in the on-call diagnostics workflow. Motivation: when on-call receives an automated diagnostics summary we want to make it faster to identify and execute remediation by surfacing the most relevant runbooks with one-click links and a short rationale. This reduces time-to-action and ties diagnostics to runbook effectiveness metrics. Changes included: Add a runbook suggester component that ranks runbooks by signal (SLO tags, recent incident matches, historical success rate) and attaches a confidence score. Extend diagnostics API to return a list of 'actionable_runbooks' with url, title, short_summary, confidence. Update on-call notifier to render prioritized runbook quick-links in Slack and PagerDuty messages (compact view + expand for details). Telemetry: emit runbook_suggestion.* events for evaluation and A/B rollout. Feature gated behind FF:oncall_runbook_links for gradual rollout. Backfill small migration to populate runbook tag index used by suggester. Testing & rollout: Unit tests for suggester heuristics and proto changes. Integration tests covering end-to-end diagnostics -> notifier rendering. Manual canary in staging for 48h with FF toggled on for a small subset of teams. Metrics dashboard added to monitor click-through and suggest-to-success ratio. Checklist: [x] Design doc (linked in PR) [x] Unit tests [x] Integration tests (ci) [x] Feature flag gating [x] Telemetry & dashboards [x] Docs updated (oncall runbooks guide). Backward compatibility: API adds an optional field; existing consumers ignore unknown fields. No breaking changes expected. Related: ENG-4521 (reduce MTTA for SLO alerts), PM-231 (on-call UX improvements).
